approved_claims: A clearer website can make a local business easier to understand and contact.
Mobile-first action paths can reduce friction for calls, bookings, orders, visits, or quote requests.
Reviews, photos, service/menu details, hours, location, and trust sections can help buyers decide.
A free homepage mockup/demo gives a concrete visual comparison before discussing a paid site.

buyer_personas.name: Restaurant owner with no website
buyer_personas.primary_wedge: Google and social help people find the restaurant; the website helps them act through menu, hours, location, photos, reviews, and booking/order/call path.

buyer_personas.name: Beauty salon using Instagram or booking app
buyer_personas.primary_wedge: Instagram gets attention; the website turns interest into booking through services, price/service types, reviews, photos, and one booking path.

buyer_personas.name: Plumber seeking emergency calls
buyer_personas.primary_wedge: Mobile click-to-call, emergency service section, service area, reviews/trust, and quote/call path.

buyer_personas.name: Owner with strong current website
buyer_personas.primary_wedge: Disqualify if no problem; answer briefly only if they re-engage with curiosity.

campaign_specific_test_cases.expected_behavior: Use restaurant-specific action path and ask for mockup permission.
Use Instagram-to-booking wedge without generic repetition.
campaign_specific_test_cases.scenario: Beauty salon says Instagram and booking app are enough.

campaign_specific_test_cases.expected_behavior: Use emergency mobile click-to-call value without fake lead-system claims.
campaign_specific_test_cases.scenario: Plumber asks how site helps emergency calls.

close_paths.allowed_when: Buyer has a relevant website gap or curiosity.
close_paths.commitment: permission to prepare free homepage mockup/demo
close_paths.spoken_close: Would it be useful if we prepared a free homepage mockup so you can see whether this direction is worth a proper conversation?

close_paths.allowed_when: Buyer wants a conversation before reviewing a mockup.
close_paths.spoken_close: Would a short review of the current site and a possible homepage direction be useful?

close_paths.allowed_when: Buyer is not the decision maker.

disqualification_logic: Stop if the buyer asks to stop or clearly refuses.
Disqualify if the current site works, the buyer has no problem, and the buyer shows no curiosity.
Disqualify if the buyer requires guaranteed leads, revenue, calls, sales, walk-ins, or rankings.
Disqualify or hand off if the buyer requires unavailable side-effect actions.
forbidden_claims: Guaranteed leads, revenue, calls, bookings, sales, walk-ins, or rankings.
Official platform authority or third-party partnership.
Final public pricing or final contract terms from internal test ranges.
Email sent, meeting booked, callback scheduled, CRM updated, mockup created, form submitted, payment collected, or account changed.

does: Creates a proposed homepage direction for review.
Builds local business websites with clearer mobile action paths.
Helps present services, menu, hours, location, reviews, photos, trust signals, and calls to action.
does_not_do: Does not guarantee leads, revenue, rankings, or sales.
Does not send emails, book meetings, schedule callbacks, update CRM, collect payment, submit forms, or create mockups during the call.
Does not provide final public pricing from internal test ranges.
normalized_product_facts.offer_summary: A free homepage mockup/demo for a local business website.

objection_playbooks.approved_response: Instagram gets attention. The website turns that interest into action with services, price or service types, reviews, photos, and one booking path.
If the current site is doing the job, that may be a no-fit. If you are curious, I can share one quick angle and you can decide if a mockup is worth seeing.
objection_playbooks.objection: We already have a strong website

objection_playbooks.approved_response: The current test ranges are Starter Website: $500-$900, Growth Website: $1,000-$2,000, Premium/custom: $2,000+, and optional Monthly Care Plan: $50-$150/month. Scope affects final quote, and the free mockup is the low-risk first step.

Ask whether phone visitors can call, book, order, or request a quote easily.
Ask who normally reviews website or marketing changes.
Ask one question at a time.
